cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 44 on-track passes, 41 pit stops, 4 cars that never finished, 2 virtual safety cars.

cards.title: 18 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Ocon, Alonso and Piastri gained the most by the end of it, 3 places at best
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 13 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: First up, lap 1: Perez, false start
1 ended in a penalty, 8 in no further action and 4 left for after the race

cards.title: 18 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Antonelli and Norris lost 3 each, the most of anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.title: Hulkenberg: 10 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 2 to lap 11, at racing speed.
bullets: 8 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Lap 11: an incident between Hamilton and Verstappen at Turn 6. What do you give?
cards.text: Race control has flagged it and it lands on your desk. Same call the stewards had to make.
state: Forcing Another Driver Off The Track at Turn 6

outcomes.none: You let it go. Nobody loses a place at a desk, and the driver behind spends the rest of the race on the radio.
outcomes.5: Five seconds gets added at the next stop, or to the final time if there is no stop left. Usually one position, sometimes none.
outcomes.10: Ten seconds is a real punishment and it almost always costs track position, which is why teams argue so hard about it.

cards.reveal: The stewards took no further action.

cards.title: 6 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap
6 cars stopped within a lap of it, and new tyres against old ones make passing far easier

cards.title: Track steady around 49°C all race
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Hamilton: 6 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in a Ferrari.
bullets: P3 on the grid, P5 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Russell was leading when it was called
Antonelli, Bearman, Alonso and 2 others stopped under it
Lifted on lap 26
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.text: His race ends on lap 24 of 71, in a Williams.
bullets: Running P14 when that lap began
Started P17
2 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: 41 stops, and the busiest lap saw 5 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 18, with 5 cars in
Shortest time in the pit lane: Leclerc, 21.0s
Longest: Alonso, 28.7s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 5 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track

cards.title: Piastri and Antonelli hit 334 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Antonelli on lap 59, 1:10.374, in a Mercedes.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: You are Verstappen, 1.9s behind Russell and going nowhere. Now what?
cards.text: Stuck behind another car your tyres overheat and the car will not turn. Stopping first gives you clean track for two or three laps, which is the whole trick behind the undercut.

choices.label: Box now and undercut
choices.sub: Fresh tyres, clean air, two laps to make it pay

choices.label: Stay out and overcut
choices.sub: Let him stop first, then push on an empty track

choices.label: Forget strategy, pass him
choices.sub: Send it and take the risk

outcomes.box: You spend about 22s in the lane and come out in traffic, betting that two fast laps on new tyres are worth more than the place you just gave up.
outcomes.wait: You stay on old rubber while he gets new ones, and you need clean air plus a mistake from him to make it work.
outcomes.attack: Passing a car with the same tyres on the same fuel is the hardest thing in the sport, and running into the back of him ends both races.

cards.reveal: Verstappen came in on lap 49, 12 laps after this. He finished P2, Russell P1.

cards.title: 1 penalty handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Alonso: a 5s penalty for speeding in the pit lane
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Stroll, on lap 46 of 71. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: 114 blue flags waved
cards.text: That is how often a lapped car was told to let the leaders through.

cards.title: Stroll is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 46 of 71, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: Running P18 when that lap began
Started P22
1 on-track pass before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Stroll was running P18 when his race ended on lap 46. Where does he finish if it had not?
cards.text: Nobody can answer this one for certain. You have his own lap times to go on and nothing else.

choices.label: He stays about where he was

cards.reveal: Our read from his own lap times, not a fact. He was lapping 3.79s a lap slower than Russell, who went on to win it. With 25 laps left, "he stays about where he was" is the honest guess, and nobody gets to check.

cards.title: Russell had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Russell was leading when it was called
Gasly took a stop under it
Lifted on lap 52
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: Antonelli: 1:10.374
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Mercedes.
bullets: Set on lap 59 of 71, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Leclerc went the other way: 6 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P2 on the grid, P8 at the flag
3 stops when most of the field made 2
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 71 of them

cards.title: Piastri: P7 on the grid, P4 at the flag
cards.text: 3 places gained.
bullets: 1 on-track pass along the way

cards.title: Ocon ran one set for 36 laps
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the hards, lap 34 to lap 69
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: Russell wins it
cards.text: P1 Russell · P2 Verstappen · P3 Antonelli.
bullets: After 71 laps, Verstappen crossed the line 1.611s behind
cards.note: Less than the time it takes to read this sentence.

cards.title: How far behind was Verstappen at the flag?
cards.text: 71 laps, 1 hour 27 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
cards.reveal: 1.611 seconds after 71 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 22s today, which is 13 times the margin this race was decided by.
